name: natural-date-field
title: Natural date field
description: Type a date the way you would say it, such as tomorrow, next friday or in 3 weeks, and see the date it was understood as before you commit.
docs: value and onValueChange speak an ISO date (2026-10-23) or null; the second argument says whether it is inside min and max. Pass now and timeZone so tomorrow is the same day on the server and in the browser. The calendar button's Calendar reads the browser's own clock. parseNaturalDate is the parser as a function.
